name: Free PDF SDK
tagline: The embeddable PDF viewer and annotator for the web
description: Free PDF SDK is an embeddable, white-label PDF viewer, annotator and editor for web apps. It runs entirely in the browser, works with React, Vue, Angular, Svelte and plain JavaScript, and lets you choose exactly which features your users see.
homeTitle: Free PDF SDK: Open-Source JavaScript PDF Viewer and Editor
homeDescription: Free, open-source PDF SDK based on PdfCraft by ArtCraft: a PDF viewer, annotator and editor for React, Vue, Angular, Svelte or plain JavaScript, running fully in the browser.
